name: Xiaomi MiMo Claw
desc: Cloud-hosted personal agent built on the OpenClaw framework
desc_zh: 小米的云端轻量智能体，一键跑起 OpenClaw
solves: Running OpenClaw yourself means server setup and maintenance. MiMo Claw hosts it in the cloud with a workspace you open in a browser.
solves_zh: 自己部署 OpenClaw 要配服务器、常维护。它把智能体托管在云端，浏览器里直接用。
best_for: You want to try an OpenClaw agent today without renting or configuring a server.
best_for_zh: 想今天就用上 OpenClaw 智能体，却不想租服务器、配环境的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://mimo.mi.com/ (product matrix) and https://mimo.mi.com/llms.txt (News）。 Two launch dates exist and both are official: free global beta V1.0.0 on 2026-03-19, and the paid 'official release' V2.0.0 on 2026-06-16 (changelog heading 'MiMo Claw: Official Monetization Version Released'; the news item 'Xiaomi MiMo Claw Official Release | Flagship Model + Kingsoft Office Ecosystem, New Subscription Service Launched' at https://mimo.mi.com/static/docs/news/latest/mimoclaw.md carries no date in its text). The earlier public beta is used as first public availability. The product is built on the open-source OpenClaw framework and is not related to Huawei 小艺Claw or Moonshot Kimi Claw beyond the shared 'Claw' naming. The entry page title reads 'Xiaomi MiMo Studio' because Claw is a tab of the same web app. SECOND SOURCE NOT YET READ: the OSCHINA URL came from a search summary and the page is a JS-rendered app that returned only its header to scripted fetches; it still needs one read through a rendering client, or replacement by another outlet. 首次公开日期来源：https://mimo.mi.com/static/docs/updates/feature/claw.md
